statement: SpaceX reported AI revenues of $2.6 billion in Q2 2026, up 213% quarter-over-quarter and 247% year-over-year, funding compute targets of more than 2 gigawatts by end-2026 and about 10 gigawatts by end-2027.
why: Revenue growth of this rate at a self-declared NVIDIA-exclusive buyer, paired with an explicit gigawatt build path, is a direct read on downstream funding available for merchant-GPU purchases.

impact.mechanism: Fast-growing AI service revenue underwrites the capital for a 2GW-to-10GW compute buildout, which converts into GPU, datacenter and power-generation demand.

evidence.excerpt: SpaceX AI revenues: $2.6 billion, 213% quarter-over-quarter growth, 247% year-over-year growth.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet reporting a customer's earnings figures; no filing-tier source in hand, so capped at medium.
